Schumer constantly lectures Americans about "protecting democracy,” all while working to trick voters.

Alaskans should reject this fraud and reject Mary Peltola, who is working with Schumer to pull it off.

Chuck Schumer recruited a Democrat in Alaska with the same name as Sen. Dan Sullivan to run as a “Republican.”

Why?

To trick Alaska voters in the voting booth. 

That's how shameless and dishonest Chuck Schumer is.

For years, Chuck Schumer has recruited fake independents to run in red states (like the far-left fraud Dan Osborn) because he knows Democrats can’t win if they’re honest.

Now, he’s taken it to the next level in Alaska.

Cole Jester has been a champion in helping make Arkansas's elections the best in the country. 

While blue states like California count ballots for weeks and months (and, coincidentally, the late ballots ALWAY favor Dems), Arkansas's results come fast and accurate.


Cole Jester (@Cole_Jester)
